Questions we hear every week.

Will my system work during a power outage?

Yes. Hybrid systems with a battery switch over automatically and keep your chosen circuits running. Systems without a battery shut down for safety when the grid fails.

Do I need municipal approval?

Most municipalities require registration of grid-connected solar. We prepare and submit the paperwork as part of every installation.

Will solar affect my home insurance?

You should notify your insurer. Many insurers cover solar installed by certified electricians with a Certificate of Compliance, which we supply.

How long do panels and batteries last?

Quality panels are warrantied for 25 years of output. Lithium batteries typically carry 10 year warranties.

Can I finance my system?

Yes. Many homeowners use a home-loan top-up or instalment finance. See our finance options.
